brief:
Settler militias attacked farmers in Turmusayya, north of Ramallah, and set fire to a vehicle during the assault, the Ma'an news agency reported. The incident occurred as Palestinian farmers worked in the area.

Details of casualties or the full scale of damage were not immediately available. Turmusayya has witnessed repeated confrontations between Palestinian residents and Israeli settlers in recent years.
title: Settlers torch vehicle during attack on farmers in Turmusayya
